title: Adaptive soft-fence + reservation recalibration runbook for noisy-tenant surge events
creator: Maya Chen
description: Summary: During a high-severity capacity incident on 2026-02-08 a single tenant’s bursty inference pattern caused sustained KV-cache churn and a token-burst exhaustion that propagated noisy-neighbor effects across a dedicated GPU pool. This ticket captures the post-incident runbook, detection rules, automated mitigation (soft-fence), a reservation recalibration flow, burst-window tuning, and tracking for rollout to all dedicated clusters. The goal is to contain noisy tenants before they force evictions or degrade other tenants’ P99 latency beyond SLOs.
postmortem_summary: Root cause analysis indicates three contributing factors: (1) a tenant workload that transitioned from inference-optimized short sequences to multi-request long-context patterns without updated reservation sizing; (2) current burst token algorithm allowed multi-minute sustained bursts because decay windows were too long; (3) observability gaps made detection and automated containment slow (alerts triggered after evictions began). Result: 3% of active tenants experienced >2x P99 latency for 18 minutes and two eviction events in cluster dc-us-west-2-03.

Create automatic fallback routing to compatible lower-memory model variant when a tenant hits soft-fence twice in 24h — owner: Kai O'Neill — due: 2026-03-25
Instrument KV cache eviction metrics + per-tenant cache hit-rate dashboards and add alert (hit-rate drop > 30% AND P99 latency delta > 50%) — owner: Arjun Patel & Observability — due: 2026-03-05
Run 48-hour synthetic tenant test that simulates mixed short/long-context switching and validate no cross-tenant P99 > 1.5x baseline — owner: QA SRE team (test plan in linked doc) — due: 2026-03-18
acceptance_criteria: Canary clusters show: max P99 tail latency uplift per non-noisy tenant <= 1.2x during synthetic test
No eviction events triggered by noisy tenants in canary clusters for 72 hours after soft-fence enabled
Automated reservation recommendations produced with coverage >= 90% of active tenants and 0 destructive changes for first two runs
Alerting detects noisy-tenant pattern and triggers soft-fence within 60 seconds of threshold breach in >= 90% of incidents
Telemetry queries and dashboards updated and linked in runbook; on-call runbook steps verified in playbook run

telemetry_queries: PromQL: sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="runtime"}[1m])) by (tenant) / ignoring(le) group_left sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_count{job="runtime"}[1m])) by (tenant)  # per-tenant latency histogram aggregation
PromQL: increase(burst_credit_consumed_total[5m]) by (tenant) > 1000  # high sustained burst consumption
PromQL: (kv_cache_misses_total{pool="dedicated"} / kv_cache_requests_total{pool="dedicated"}) by (tenant) > 0.3 and increase(eviction_events_total[10m]) > 0  # hit-rate drop plus evictions

SQL: select tenant_id, percentile_cont(0.99) within group (order by duration_ms) as p99 from request_spans where timestamp > now() - interval '15 minutes' group by tenant_id order by p99 desc limit 50
